title: Restrict AppConfig to a single instance
hints: Add a private static field of type AppConfig to hold the single instance
Make the constructor private so callers cannot use new AppConfig()
Add a public static getInstance() method that creates the instance on first call and returns it every time
issues: AppConfig can be instantiated freely with new AppConfig()
Each caller gets its own separate config, so changes made in one place are invisible elsewhere
goals: Only one AppConfig instance can ever exist
getInstance() always returns the same object
State changes are visible to all callers that hold a reference
